name: Rugaru
description: A wolf-headed humanoid cursed by the gods to prowl the swamps in search of blood.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The Rugaru can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

abilities.name: Child of Night
abilities.description: While in moonlight, the Rugaru gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty.

abilities.name: Bloodthirsty
abilities.description: When a PC marks HP from the Rugaru’s standard attack, add a token to this stat block. The Rugaru gains a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. Clear all tokens when the Rugaru takes Severe damage.

abilities.name: Howl at the Moon
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail lose a Hope. Gain a Fear for each Hope lost. If a PC has no Hope, they must mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

abilities.name: Flesh Ripper
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d12+2 direct physical damage.
